strings.backup.usage.head: Commands:
strings.backup.usage.list: list [--to folder] [--project name]: the backups in a folder, newest first, and whether the project has changed since the last one.
strings.backup.usage.now: now [--to folder] [--project name] [--yes] [--without-saved-points]: make a checked backup of a project's recordings, notes and finished voices. It shows what it will do and asks first.
strings.backup.usage.options: --yes answers yes to the question now or restore asks. --to names the folder the backups are kept in. The default is the folder used last, or this tool's own backups folder.
strings.backup.usage.restore: restore file [--yes]: put a backup back. It only adds what is missing and never replaces a file. It shows what it will do and asks first.
strings.backup.usage.verify: verify file: read a backup all the way through and check every file in it. It changes nothing.

strings.rounds.usage.stop: stop [--project name]: ask the running round to stop. It saves what it can first. Asks first.

strings.voicefile.usage.head: Commands:

strings.voicefile.usage.listen: listen [--yes] [--project name] [--folder name] [--round number]: hear the voice on this computer before it goes to the phone. It shows what it will do and asks first.
